item.text: I’ll read the point definition and pinned sources in `context.json`, then build one source-grounded ASCII tree.

import json
x=json.load(open('context.json'))
for i,s in enumerate(x['sources']): print(i,s['path'],len(s['text']))
for i in [4,5,6]:
 s=x['sources'][i]; print('\\nSOURCE '+s['path']+'\\n'+s['text'])
PY"

{"ascii":"Immutable Diagram Model - shared value for canvas, agents, history, and storage
|-- [M] Value boundary: Diagram + DiagramRevision
|   |-- Diagram
|   |   |-- diagramId: stable service identity; id: local canvas content key
|   |   |-- revisionId: service revision identity; revision: content revision number
|   |   |-- content: ASCII + SHA-256 + content revision ID + versioned structure
|   |   |-- sourceContext: content hash + mappings + evidence + optional source binding
|   |   `-- optional highlights and jumps
|   |-- DiagramRevision wraps the value
|   |   `-- id + diagramId + optional parentId + diagram + nodeRefs
|   |       `-- nodeRefs: revision-scoped content node ID -> logical node identity
|   `-- Exposed operations
|       |-- createDiagram / reviseDiagram / deriveDiagram -> immutable revision result
|       |-- diagramContentNodes -> common node representation
|       |-- diagramSource -> selection, entries, and search over source evidence
|       `-- DiagramRevisionEditor.resolve -> cloned view with logical node IDs
|           `-- revision lookup and correspondence checks stay private to the editor
|-- [D] Parsed nodes depend on ASCII, content revision, and pinned parser version
|   |-- buildDiagramContent
|   |   |-- validates printable ASCII + LF, at most 20000 characters
|   |   |   `-- empty text rejected except a blank rectangular diagram placeholder
|   |   |-- computes ASCII hash; rejects parser versions incompatible with structure kind
|   |   `-- new content defaults: tree -> ascii-tree-2; diagram -> ascii-graph-1
|   |-- Tree content: parsed nodes stored inside content.structure
|   |   |-- parseAsciiTree -> parseDiagram with tree compatibility profile
|   |   |   `-- zero tree/wire tolerance; separate continuations; no repairs
|   |   |-- node IDs depend on content revision ID + ASCII hash + line
|   |   `-- roots + parent/child links + label geometry + fold ranges
|   |       `-- visibleContentLines uses collapsed node IDs and fold ranges
|   |-- Diagram content: diagramContentNodes derives an index [shared N]
|   |   |-- ascii-graph-1 -> parseAsciiGraph -> boxes projected into content nodes
|   |   |   |-- recognizes frames, text blocks, tree relationships, and wires
|   |   |   |-- parser returns boxes and edges; node projection uses boxes
|   |   |   `-- multiline spans retained; local identity uses first text span
|   |   `-- no parserVersion -> legacy parseDiagram, mixed dialect
|   |       `-- separate continuations; no repairs; preserve legacy node derivation
|   |-- Rebuilds use contentParserVersion, preserving stored node-reference keys
|   `-- validateDiagram checks the joined value
|       |-- rebuild content with its pinned parser -> require exact canonical equality
|       |-- sourceContext.contentHash must equal hash(content.ascii)
|       |-- mappings join evidence[entityId].sourceRanges[sourceRangeIndex]
|       |   `-- require an existing range and matching sourceRangeId when supplied
|       |-- evidence retains relative paths, line bounds, and original source lines
|       |-- optional binding validates corpus/profile compatibility and absolute root
|       `-- also validates local mappings, highlights, and jumps
|-- [C] Revision creation and editing
|   |-- createDiagram(input)
|   |   `-- editor.prepareCreate -> constructDiagram -> issueDiagramRevision
|   |-- reviseDiagram(base, edit)
|   |   |-- editor.prepareEdit resolves the base through supplied context bindings
|   |   |   |-- source-mappings: require expected ASCII hash; clone new source data
|   |   |   |-- patch / patches: call patchDiagramRanges; optionally retain mappings
|   |   |   |-- replace: construct next content revision; rebase jumps and highlights
|   |   |   |-- highlights / jumps: validate the supplied annotations
|   |   |   `-- explicit node correspondence supplements inferred correspondence
|   |   |       |-- each logical ref must identify one old node and one output-line node
|   |   |       `-- reject conflicts and multiple identities claiming the same node
|   |   |-- unchanged diagram object -> return the base revision
|   |   `-- otherwise keep diagramId, allocate revisionId, then issueDiagramRevision
|   |-- deriveDiagram(base, input, refs, sources)
|   |   |-- identity sources must belong to the same diagram
|   |   `-- requested refs must be allowed and map uniquely to output nodes
|   `-- issueDiagramRevision [internal]
|       |-- link parentId to base revision when present
|       |-- assign logical refs to nodes from [shared N] or stored tree nodes
|       |   |-- explicitly supplied identity -> reuse it
|       |   |-- proven old-to-new correspondence -> inherit base.nodeRefs
|       |   `-- otherwise -> allocate a fresh logical node identity
|       `-- deep-freeze record -> validateDiagram -> return revision and correspondence
|-- [M] Edit scope and reference consumers depend on the common node model
|   |-- Subtree replacement boundary
|   |   |-- resolve revision-pinned roots through diagramContentNodes
|   |   |-- traverse childIds; reject ranges containing unrelated nodes
|   |   |-- single / contiguous / disjoint modes enforce target counts and separation
|   |   `-- scopedReplacements -> patches only when all outside lines remain exact
|   |-- Identity continuity
|   |   |-- correspondingNodes requires identical ASCII and structure kind
|   |   |   `-- then matches unique nodes by line, columns, and label
|   |   `-- changed content needs edit correspondence; preview heuristics cannot anchor it
|   |-- Connection endpoints
|   |   |-- content anchor: display box + content node ID + content revision ID
|   |   |-- strict validation requires an existing box and a current content node
|   |   |   `-- collection validation permits anchors pinned to older revisions
|   |   `-- reconcileConnections(before, after, edges, nodeIds)
|   |       |-- deleted display box -> remove incident edges
|   |       |-- proven node mapping -> update endpoint node and revision
|   |       |-- identical ASCII/kind -> allow positional fallback
|   |       `-- otherwise retain stale anchor; do not guess a new endpoint
|   `-- Context merge boundary
|       `-- baseline binding differs from current -> MERGE_REQUIRED
|           `-- automatic three-way merge is not implemented
`-- [O] State ownership and retention
    |-- Domain operations create frozen revisions without publishing or storing them
    |-- Editor receives revision records and a context-binding callback
    |   `-- canvas history supplies bindings; resolve returns a clone of the view
    |-- Derived diagram-node cache is a private WeakMap keyed by content object
    |   `-- derived arrays are frozen; cache keys do not keep content alive
    `-- Runtime revision store explicitly retains results
        |-- retainDiagramRevision -> importDiagramRevision -> registry.register
        |   `-- every current content node must have a nonempty, unique logical ref
        |-- get/list expose retained revisions and frozen revision summaries
        |-- stored command wrappers combine domain operations with retention
        `-- durable adapters must flush retained revisions before publishing bindings"}
